# Senior Staff Manufacturing Engineer — Boston Dynamics (Atlas)

---

**Job ID:** R2966
**Date Posted:** ~Aug 4, 2026 ("Posted 4 Days Ago" as viewed Aug 8, 2026)
**Date Applied:** Aug 8, 2026
**Salary Range:** $135,000 – $170,000

---

## Job Summary

Supports the Atlas humanoid robot program, transforming research prototypes into reliable, scalable manufacturing and field-deployment systems. Works closely with Hardware Engineering, Prototype Operations, Systems, Behavior, and Software teams, and interfaces with parent company Hyundai Motor Group's automotive manufacturing expertise. Waltham, MA office.

---

## What You'll Do

- Develop, optimize, and implement rate-production processes and assembly workflows for Atlas, scaling from prototype to low-volume production.
- Design production system tools (material flow diagrams, value stream maps, floor layouts, automation integrations); provide DFM/DFA input to Hardware Engineering.
- Design, fabricate, and validate custom fixtures/tools/jigs for precision motor and actuator assembly; define SOPs and work instructions.
- Support prototype builds hands-on; implement process controls, FAI, and in-process quality checks; lead Lean/Six Sigma continuous-improvement initiatives.

### Required Qualifications
- BS in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical Engineering, or related (Master's/PhD a plus)
- 8–15 years in process engineering/process development/advanced manufacturing (robotics, aerospace, or complex electromechanical systems preferred)
- Expert CAD (SolidWorks, CATIA, or similar); proven DFM/DFA collaboration; hands-on custom tooling/jig/fixture development and validation
- Strong GD&T understanding; Lean Manufacturing/Six Sigma/root-cause-analysis experience; precision assembly techniques (alignment, shimming, torque control)

Nice to have: CNC process development for novel materials/gear manufacturing, humanoid/robotic program experience, PLM/MES experience, TWI Job Instruction/Job Methods certification.

### Education
BS in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; Master's or PhD a plus.

### Benefits
Not itemized beyond stated base pay range; standard Boston Dynamics compensation practices per Massachusetts pay-transparency law.

## About the Company

Boston Dynamics is a global robotics leader (Atlas, Spot, Stretch) blending mechanical design, control systems, and AI-driven perception for robots operating in unstructured real-world environments, and is building a commercial automation business for industrial and warehouse-logistics customers.
